summary: Iteration 4 (Dark Menu QR, Waitlist w/ mocked SMS, Combo Deals engine, Manager PIN override, Repeat Round) fully tested. Backend pytest 10/10 passed across public menu, pin-verify, waitlist CRUD+notify+seat, combo CRUD, and combo engine (both-in / one-only / deactivated). Frontend Playwright verified: public /m/{tid} renders without auth (cats=9 prods=4, search filter narrows results, no /login redirect); Waitlist add/notify/seat flow with UI status flip to 'Notified' and row removal on seat; Combo editor gates save until name+2 products; Register combo auto-apply shows combo-line-0 (Combo · TEST_ComboAuto -HK$22.95 on HK$153 subtotal → total HK$143.06), Repeat Round doubles lines (2→4), removing required product removes combo-line; QR modal opens with img from api.qrserver.com + qr-url + qr-copy/qr-print buttons; ManagerPin gate correctly appears for server on saved-order line-del, wrong-role PIN 3333 shows 'Requires manager, admin' toast and leaves modal open, and manager PIN 1111 auto-submits+closes modal (line voided).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _compute_totals treats missing discount_type as 'none' via elif chain — fine, but combo detection uses set.issubset(line_pids), meaning duplicate qty of same product still counts once (correct). No qty threshold on combos though — if spec ever wants 'buy 2 of X + 1 of Y', current model can't express it. Only 'all product_ids present at qty>=1' is supported.
public/menu/{table_id} exposes full products list without any rate limiting — public route open to internet. Consider adding basic rate limit / caching layer once traffic ramps.
waitlist notify mocked response returns phone in mocked_sms_to — fine per spec. Real integration will need provider (Twilio) creds; keep this shape stable.

ManagerPin auto-submits when pin.length===4 which is nice UX, but if requiredRoles requires a 5-6 digit pin ever, only first 4 chars would be submitted. Current seed uses 4-digit PINs so no bug today.
Register.jsx pinGate is bypassed for order.id==null (draft) and role∈{admin,manager}. Correct per spec agent_to_agent_context_note.
test_credentials: Sourced from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin polymuze111@gmail.com/admin123 (PIN 9999), manager PIN 1111, server server@hkbar.com/server123 (PIN 3333).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create+cleanup TEST_Alpha/TEST_Bravo waitlist entries, TEST_ComboAB combo (+3 draft orders voided). Frontend created TEST_WLAlice (seated), TEST_ComboUI4 + TEST_ComboAuto combos (deleted), and one saved order on T5 voided after manager PIN test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression command: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://hk-bar-pos-pro.preview.emergentagent.com pytest -o addopts= backend/tests/test_iteration4.py -v`. Note: Register.jsx does not have data-testid='mgr-pin-clear' or 'mgr-pin-backspace' — component uses 'mgr-pin-back' (delete key) and auto-submits at 4 digits, so tests should type 4 digits without clicking enter. Second-login flakiness in Playwright requires localStorage.clear() + cookies clear before /login navigation. TableActionModal's continue button text is 'Continue Order' (case-insensitive match works).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. Initial Playwright miss (prod-Tsingtao not found) was because Register.jsx groups products by category — fixed by clicking data-testid='cat-Beer'/'cat-Starters' first.
